trinkets:
Trinkets
A data-driven accessory mod for Minecraft using Fabric.

 

 About
Trinkets adds a slot group and slot system to Minecraft. Slot groups are collections of slots for a certain body part or more vague area. By default there are 6 slot groups (head, chest, legs, feet, offhand, hand) that can have slots added to them, but more groups can be added if desired. Trinkets' UI is intuitive to use, accessible, and attempts to do away with clutter. Its system means that you'll never have a slot that's not used for anything, as mods request the slots they want.

For basic tutorials and comprehensive documentation, visit this project's wiki.

macos-input-fixes:
Fixes MC-122296

Fixes MC-121772

Fixes MC-59810

Fixes MC-22882

Fixes control + tab and control + escape not being detected

 

Specific fixes:

- Correctly detects left click while control is pressed
- Make trackpad scrolling not scroll a ridiculous number of items at once
- It also fixes momentum scrolling (which changes the number of scroll events based on how quickly you did it, even by like x5-10, meaning you couldn't easily scroll to the correct item)
- On the trackpad it also only considers scrolling while fingers are on the trackpad (and the same for any fancy mice that support the relevant api e.g. probably apple's fancy mice/trackpad thing)
- It also fixes scrolling being broken when shift is down on some older mice.
- When dropping an item, Minecraft checks for command + the key, since the default key is Q, this doesn't make sense, so this mod allows both control + key and c

修复MC-122296 修复MC-121772 修复MC-59810 修复MC-22882 修复了未检测到的control + tab和control + escape 按下控件时正确检测左键单击 - 使触控板滚动不滚动一个荒谬的项目数量一次 - 它还修复了动量滚动（这会根据你的速度来改变滚动事件的数量，甚至是x5-10，这意味着你不能轻松地滚动到正确的项目） - 在触控板上，它也只考虑当手指在触控板上时的滚动（对于任何支持相关API的花哨鼠标也是如此，例如可能是苹果的花哨鼠标/触控板） - 它还修复了滚动被打破时，转移是对一些老老鼠。 - 当放下一个项目时，Minecraft检查命令+键，因为默认键是Q，这没有意义，所以这个模组允许控制+键和c - When dropping an item, Minecraft checks for command + the key, since the default key is Q, this doesn't make sense, so this 模组 allows both control + key and c

This mod provides a framework for creating progression systems in modpacks. These progression systems are based on stages which are player specific flags used to track their progress. Using other mods and addons you can configure the game to react differently to a player depending on the stages they have unlocked. While the term stage may imply a linear progression they can be used for virtually all types of progression systems. Some common examples of this include using stages for RPG classes and skills, Pack modes (expert, hardcore, easy), and branching quests. 

 For specific information on how to use GameStages, please refer to the GitHub page that matches with the version of the mod you are using. You can also join my Discord server for help and further discussion. You can find a list of all mods that support GameStages here.

 What is e4mc?

e4mc is a reverse tunneling reverse proxy for Minecraft. In simpler terms, it's a software that allows you to temporarily expose a local Minecraft server to the internet.

 How do I use it?

Simply install the mod, and Open to LAN as normal. A public domain will appear alongside the local port. Others can simply connect to the public domain to connect to your LAN server.

natural-temperature:
---

 Natural Temperature

Natural Temperature turns Minecraft's random patchwork of biomes into a world with real climate zones. It replaces the vanilla biome placement with an organic, believable, immersive and configurable latitude based system:

- Ice at the poles
- Taigas and tundra in the cold north
- Temperate forests and plains in the middle
- Deserts and badlands near the tropics
- Jungles and savannas around the equator

Travel north or south and you will see the biomes change based on the latitude.

 

This creates coherent worlds, and as the biomes follow climate logic instead of random noise, exploring feels like travelling across the planet. 
The new distribution, especially combined with other world generation mods, creates regions and beautiful environments perfect for finding the right spot for your project, building realistic cities, roleplaying with nations or planning

wavify:
Wavify

 Dynamic ocean and shoreline waves for Minecraft

Wavify adds ambient water waves to oceans, beaches, shores, and islands to make Minecraft's water feel more alive and dynamic.

Waves are most noticeable along coastlines, where larger swells can roll toward beaches and rocky terrain. Waves may also interact with nearby blocks, creating more dramatic shorelines and cliffside water effects. During full moons, some waves can emit a subtle nighttime glow.

 Wavify is client-side. You can run it on any server without the server needing to install anything.

 

 About This Project

Wavify is an independently maintained fork inspired by the original Tidal mod.

This project exists to keep the wave system playable and functional on newer Minecraft versions while also addressing bugs, crashes, and gameplay issues encountered during testing. It is not an official continuation of the origin

smooth-third-person-camera:
Smooth Third Person Camera (STPC)

STPC is a lightweight, compatibility-first camera smoothing mod for Minecraft.

Instead of taking control of your camera, STPC is designed to work on top of the camera you already use — whether that's vanilla Minecraft or another camera mod.

 Features

- Smooth third-person camera movement
- FPS-independent smoothing
- Configurable smoothness and maxDistance 
- Optional Limit Break mode for direct numeric input

 Compatibility

 Compatibility is one of STPC's main goals. 

STPC tries to avoid replacing or taking control of camera behavior such as rotation, perspective, offsets, and controls. When another camera mod is installed, STPC aims to let that mod control the camera and simply smooth the resulting movement.

Support may vary depending on the Minecraft version and mod loader.

STPC is designed to coexist with other camera mods whenever possible.

This mod is a library that provides refactored data packages to allow clients to accept more Minecraft particles, enabling different players to synchronize their rendering and exceed the particle limit of 16384.
 Principle
This library prevents network issues caused by a large number of packets being sent through custom data packages. If you haven't installed the mod that calls this library, nothing unusual will happen to your client.
 Install
If you need to run it in server, you need install it in server's mod folder and client's mod folder,else you only need instal in client side

Patchouli Resource Patch - Arch

This is a Patchouli Resource Patch fork that supports Fabric/Quilt/Forge 1.15.x~1.19.x .

Since Patchouli changes to store books in /data/ , external resource packages or data packages cannot overwrite the contents of those books.

This mod uses mixin to change Patchouli's loading behavior so that it tries to load from assets before loading from data.

 Useful only for non-English players or people who want to use the resource pack applied to Patchouli books. 

About Patchouli for 1.15.x ~ 1.19.x : Some mods (like Apothesis) still put their manuals in the traditional data folder, and Patchouli won't even try to load from resource packs in this case, so this patch is still needed.

About Patchouli for 1.20.x and above : Patchouli now only support resource packs mode! This mod is no longer required.

 Dependencies
On your client you need to additionally install Just Enough Items (JEI) or Roughly Enough Items (REI)

If you use the Fabric version of JEI Trades, you also need to install FabricAPI

This makes the shown information very complete and JEI Trades able to show information for all mods that use the standard Minecraft trades system, without needing specific support for each mod.

Overview 
 Gain Friendship From Melodies(GFFM) is a simple mod that allows you to increase your Pokemon's(from the Cobblemon mod) friendship by playing music to them using the instruments from the Immersive Melodies. 
 Why I need this mod?
 We all know that Pokemon like Riolu needs a high friendship value to evolve, but it's quite hard to gain enough friendship to evolve at the early game.This mod adds a simple and fun way to increase the friendship. 
 Features
 Your Pokemon gain 2 friendship every 10 seconds if you're playing music with the instrument from Immersive Melodies. 
 The Pokemon will cry when the song is about to come to an end.(They Encore you like a Whimsicott! :p ) 
 Doesn't work on soundproof(ability) Pokemon like Exploud.
 Your Pokemon can be awaken by your music when it gains friendship.(edit the config to heal other status.)
 Your Pokemon can imitate your performance.

What even is this?
I'm glad you asked. GlowUp is a client-sided mod that applies the glowing effect to specific, configurable items on the ground.

 How can I configure what items glow?
The easiest way is to install ModMenu and Cloth Config, then go to ModMenu's mod list and configure the settings from there. You can also edit the config by hand, under .minecraft/config/glowup.toml, but this is not recommended.

 Does this mod work with other mods?
It's compatible with most if not all mods that add their own items.

 Can it highlight other entities?
No, GlowUp only highlights dropped items.

 Found a bug or want to suggest a feature?
Please head over to the Github and make an issue.

- Dimensions - Nether

The mod adds stars, planets, moons, constellations, shooting stars, auroras, sky color tints, light ribbons, and other decorative elements to the sky. In different biomes, the sky may vary in color, object set, and overall atmosphere.

Fast Crystal is the ultimate client-side PvP utility mod designed to provide a smooth and fast End Crystal combat experience. It removes placement delays and reduces ghost hitbox issues.

Features

Zero Placement Delay: Removes the vanilla 4-tick delay when holding right-click, allowing crystals to be placed as fast as the client can process them.

Instant Break & Discard: Hitting an End Crystal instantly removes its entity from the client world, reducing ghost hitbox delays and allowing another crystal to be placed in the same location without waiting for the client-side entity to disappear.

High-Speed Crystal PvP: Combines zero-delay placement with instant client-side crystal removal to provide a faster Crystal PvP experience.

Fully Toggleable: The mod can be enabled or disabled in-game at any time using a customizable keybind available in the Controls menu.

 Multi versional

It doesn’t add new gameplay features or content on its own — instead, it provides shared code, structure, and backend initialization used by other dependent mods.

itemswap:
Description
This mod provides an easy way of swapping items between inventory and hotbar slots.
There is no in-inventory item swap, because the mod uses a hotbar swap (like, hovering over a hotbar slot and pressing that hotbar slot's key to swap the items). This is less error-prone than picking up the item, placing in the other slot and placing the item that was in the slot in the previous slot. It also makes the mod undetectable on servers unless you spam the swap.

 Usage
In the inventory screen, hold the configuration key ( L by default) while hovering a slot, drag your cursor to another slot and release the configuration key. If both slots are valid, you've successfully created a mapping. A mapping can only be created between inventory/armor slots and a hotbar slot. A hotbar slot has to be involved due to how the item swap is performed.

---

Works server-side and in single player.

Scaffolding Extension adds a single gamerule, scaffolding extension:limit . This allows you to configure how far scaffolding can reach without support.

Craft From Chest is a Minecraft mod that lets you use items stored in nearby chests and other containers when you craft at a crafting table as long as you use the recipe book to fill or craft the recipe.
 The Problem It Solves
Normally, the recipe book only uses items in your inventory. If your materials are in chests, you have to open each chest, move items into your inventory (or into the crafting grid), then craft. This mod lets the recipe book “see” those chests so you can craft without moving everything into your inventory first.
How It Works In-Game
Open a crafting table and use the recipe book (the book icon in the crafting GUI).
Click a recipe to fill the grid or craft (e.g. click once to fill, again to craft).
The recipe book can now take ingredients from:
Your inventory (as usual), and
Any container within range of the crafting table: chests,

 Somnia: Community Edition is a Minecraft mod that simulates the world while you sleep.
It is a successor of Somnia Awoken, which was released in 2020, which was a successor of Somnia, released in 2011.

Instead of skipping the night, the world is accelerated while you sleep.
You can now sleep at any time as long as you have enough fatigue, which you gain passively over time.
Don't let it build up too high though - getting too tired comes with debuffs.

 Credits

Credit goes to MALfunction84 and Kingrunes, authors of the original Somnia mod, as well as Su5eD, for the original Somnia Awoken port.

 Getting started

All information is available on our wiki.

 Highlighted Features

- 🎮 Multiplayer Support
- ⌚ Custom wake time selection
- 🔧 Highly Configurable
- 🛏️ Vanilla sleep option
- 🍷 Adds potions that modify fatigue gain rate
- ...and more!

rthuds:
RTHuds is a modern, flexible, and fully modular HUD system for Minecraft. Instead of focusing on survival-specific indicators, it provides a clean and general interface foundation suitable for different gameplay styles. Each HUD element can be toggled individually, allowing players to create simple or detailed layouts based on their preferences.

The main goal of RTHuds is to give players full control over their visual experience. Its organized structure enables easy customization, repositioning, and personalization of on-screen information. Designed with performance and stability in mind, it runs smoothly even on lower-end systems and offers an accessible configuration system for both beginners and advanced users.

improved-wolf-ai:
Improved Wolf AI

Wolves in vanilla are kind of useless. They attack stuff, sure, but then they just stand there while the loot despawns. This mod fixes that.

---

 Features

 Smart Hunting - Wolves stop attacking once the target is dead. No more watching your wolf lunge at a corpse.

 Meat Collection - After a kill, your wolf grabs the meat and brings it back to you.

 Hostile Detection - Your wolf growls when hostile mobs are nearby. Works as an early warning system in caves or at night.

 Item Fetching - Crouch and your wolf will fetch nearby item drops and bring them to you. Useful for cleaning up after a fight.

---

 How It Works

- Wolves still fight normally, they just stop when the job is done
- Crouch to signal your wolf to fetch items, stand up to cancel
- Growling doesn't interrupt combat or other behaviors
- Items are visually shown in the wolf's mouth while carrying

Jugs' Calories adds new survival related mechanics like thirst, body-temperature, food-freshness and crop-nutrient system as well as a revamped, caloric based hunger system.

 Gameplay
Instead of the traditional hunger bar, you now have to consume an activity based amount of calories. lag-protect:
Lag Protect

A lightweight, server-side Fabric mod that protects players from taking damage during lag spikes. When a player's connection stops responding, damage to them is cancelled until they catch back up, so nobody dies to a frozen screen.

 How it works

The server sends each player a tiny ping on a configurable interval (default every 30 ticks). If the response is overdue by more than a second and the player has also stopped sending movement packets, they are considered lagging and incoming damage is cancelled. Protection ends the moment the client catches up.

 Gamerule

 /gamerule lag protect -- interval between pings (default 30, range 0-200, 0 disables the mod).

Lower = lag is detected faster, but packets are sent more frequently.

 Notes

Protection covers damage only. A player who stays lagged past the vanilla keepalive timeout is still disconnected as normal.

 License

mtd-offline-addon:
My Totem Doll for Offline Mode!
 
 
 
 

 

 
 Feel free to report any issues!
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 MTD Offline Addon makes My Totem Doll mod work with offline mode players. My Totem Doll alone pulls skins from Mojang API, and if a player plays in offline mode and has skin set by server (for example by Skins Restorer plugin), then MTD would not displays their skin on totem named after them, because Mojang API has no info about it. This addon fixes it, making MTD try to pull the skin from local client data first.

This addon also provides caching of offline skins, so when offline player leaves the server (and therefore their skin cannot be found in client data) their skin is loaded from cache. Cache is prioritized even for licensed accounts, but it is configurable with ModMenu and YACL.

FauxPlayers

FauxPlayers adds display-only player entries to Minecraft.

It supports:

- Paper 26.3 (single Paper JAR).
- Fabric for Minecraft 26.2 and 26.3.
- Server status responses.
- Manipulating the in-game player list.
- Relaying players from another server or HTTP source.
- Replaying an exported Discord chat history into the server.
- Simulated ping, skins, heads, and TAB scores.
- Fake player conversations and personas powered by an OpenAI compatible API.
- Fake player deaths and kills (among other fake players).

 Important

A fake player is a client display entry.
It is not a connected player.

FauxPlayers does not create:

- a connection;
- an entity;
- a login or quit event;
- a command sender;
- a Bukkit Player;
- a server-side player.

On Paper, Bukkit.getOnlinePlayers() contains only real players.
Fake entries do not change permissions, events, slots, limits, or server API

keepbedinventory:
This mod reworks how inventory saving on death is handled. It allows the player to keep some of their items and xp on death while not saving everything like the keepInventory gamerule does.

 Items

When the player sets a spawnpoint, via bed, respawn anchor or other method, all items and experience levels on the player will be saved with a timestamp.
If the player dies, then they will keep any items that they had at the time of sleeping that are still present on the player. All other items will be dropped as normal.

Only items that match the timestamp on the player will be kept, anything with a different timestamp will be dropped as normal.

Items that are timestamped, but not on the player at the time of death will not be kept.

 Experience

The player will keep the xp levels when last setting spawn or the levels had on death, whichever is lower.

react-mod:
React Mod: Action Recording & Replay Tool
React is a Minecraft mod that simplifies repetitive in-game tasks by recording and replaying player inputs with high precision.
Core Features

- Recording: Captures keyboard presses/releases, mouse movements, clicks, and scrolls when activated. Synchronously logs context data including starting position, camera angles, and flight status.

- Saving: Recordings are stored as lightweight text files in a dedicated "recordings" folder for easy management and sharing.

- Replay: Select a saved file to replicate actions accurately. Movements, jumps, camera adjustments, and natural pauses (e.g., after releasing movement keys like W) are synchronized to match the original timing.

Operations & Optimization

- Command System: Supports recording/stopping (/react record / /react stop), replay initiation (/react replay ), file management (/react list / /react

 .kdl files used in place of .json will respect data pack priority, and filtering out the .json version of a resource will filter out the respective .kdl version too.

Tired of watching the loading screen while every block model, texture, sprite and font glyph gets parsed from scratch, on every single launch?

DashLoader is a client-side cache for the resource reload. The first time you start the game it does its normal work and writes the result to disk. Every launch after that reads the cache back instead, so the world loads dramatically faster. The effect is largest on big modpacks.

Summary

Semi-hardcore is a Minecraft mod that lets you set up player lives and health penalty on death. Hardcore but if you had more than one life.

This mod requires InsaneLib

 The mod

By default, you start with 5 hearts and 6 lives. Each time you die, you gain 1 heart, up to the normal 10, but, at which point, you'll have only one life left.

 Please note that this only works in Survival. In Hardcore you still have 1 life. 

A command is available to manipulate lives / max health or to opt out of the lives and max health mechanics. /semihardcore lives /semihardcore health /semihardcore optout 

The mod also has some mcfunctions integrated to add and remove lives/health via commands / advancements reward. 
 semihardcore:gain hearth : Give 2 max health to the player. 
 semihardcore:lose hearth : Remove 2 max health from the player. 
 semihardcore:gain life : Give 1 life to the player.

A server-side mod that restricts crafting based on LuckPerms permissions.
There are three ways to prevent crafting something.

 By recipe : set restricted-crafting. to false . 
For example, to stop players crafting iron ingots from nuggets, set restricted-crafting.minecraft:iron ingot from nuggets to false . Other recipes for the same item stay craftable.

 By output item : set restricted-crafting.item. to false .
To stop players crafting an iron ingot by any recipe at all, set restricted-crafting.item.minecraft:iron ingot to false .

You can get all recipes by running /restrictedcrafting dump to list them, or find recipe ids in misode/mcmeta.

Some recipes (firework rocket, map cloning, book cloning, armor dyeing, banner duplicating, ...) build their result at craft time and they have no restricted-crafting.item node.

Villager trading often bypasses the core gameplay loop, allowing players to obtain end-game gear (like Mending books or Diamond armor) too early. This mod gives server admins and modpack creators full control over this mechanic.

 Features

 Complete Control: Globally disable trading interactions with Villagers and Wandering Traders.
 Hybrid Logic:

 Client-side: Improves UX by preventing the interaction animation (hand swing) and GUI opening entirely.
 Granular Configuration: Don't want to ban trading completely? Use the Whitelist feature to allow specific professions (e.g., allow Butchers but ban Librarians).
 Mod Menu Integration: Easily toggl

diagenesis:
Diagenesis overhauls ore vein and rock generation by making ore veins rarer but much larger and adding additional strategy to mining. Ores and vein types are now divided into a few types:
- Copper/Granite
- Coal/Andesite
- Gold/Diorite
- Iron/Tuff
- Redstone/Smooth Basalt
- Diamond/Blackstone
- Lapis Lazuli/Calcite
- Emerald/Calcite

 

Underground areas are each assigned to one of these types, similarly but independently from biomes. If you spot one of these stones, you know which ore is nearby. While it might take longer to find the specific ore you are looking for, overall ore distribution should be similar to vanilla as ore veins are significantly larger.

 Compatibility
Only affects vanilla ore generation, modded ores will continue generating as they are defined in their mod.
May be incompatible with mods that modify ore vein placement or world generation noise settings

Minecraft's sandbox is amazing, but a full survival playthrough lacks the fulfilling progression and freedom of choice required to make Minecraft a truly fantastic game .

Whittled & Wistful is a modpack that aims to change that.

Focusing on progression, exploration, and overhauling core features, this modpack makes old features feel fresh and unique without losing you in the minutiae of it all.

Like its main inspiration, Raspberry Flavoured, Whittled & Wistful makes very opinionated changes. The most noticeable of these is the lack of the End dimension or Elytras, which each encourage stagnation, complacency, and a lack of investment.

Whittled & Wistful does everything it can to reward your investment.

Whittled & Wistful是什么？ Whittled & Wistful是一款原版风格的整合包，它采用了原版的一些主要设计范式，并以一种更吸引人的方式重新想象了游戏。《我的世界》的沙盒令人惊叹，但完整的生存玩法缺乏令人满意的进程和自由选择，这是使《我的世界》成为一款真正精彩的游戏所必需的。 Whittled & Wistful是一个旨在改变这种情况的整合包。 专注于进步，探索，和大修核心功能，这个整合包使旧的功能感觉新鲜和独特的，而不会失去你在这一切的细节。 就像它的主要灵感一样，树莓味的，Whittled & Wistful做出了非常固执己见的改变。其中最值得注意的是缺乏结束维度或Elytras，每一个都鼓励停滞，自满和缺乏投资。 Whittled & Wistful会尽一切努力来回报你的投资。

Sky High is a small data pack that does one thing: Increasing the Overworld height from -64 to 320, to -64 to 1024 blocks (1088 blocks total).
This data pack should be compatible with any world, but always back up your world first, before enabling or disabling this data pack.

FAQ:

Q: What happens if I remove this data pack after I built beyond the vanilla world height? 
A: Upon world reloading all blocks placed above vanilla build limit will be gone.

Q: When joining my world I get a warning about experimental settings, is there a way to disable that? 
A: Yes, if you are using fabric, you can use this mod.

spark-scatter:
Spark Scatter

Adds subtle visual feedback to redstone machinery. When pistons extend, they release a small burst of smoke particles. Hoppers transferring items emit tiny dust particles in the direction of transfer. Dispensers and droppers produce a quick flash of crit particles when firing. Observers pulse with brief electric particles when detecting block updates. Comparators emit faint redstone particles based on their signal strength output.

Particles only spawn on actual activation events rather than constant emission, so performance impact is minimal. The system runs server-wide, meaning all players benefit from the enhanced visual feedback regardless of who built the machinery.

Each particle effect is deliberately minimal, lasting only a few ticks, ensuring dense redstone builds remain visually readable. Technical players can use the particle cues for debugging complex circuits,

Overview
 
The British Rail Class 221 Super Voyager is a class of tilting diesel-electric multiple unit express passenger trains built in Bruges, Belgium and Wakefield, by Bombardier Transportation in 2001–02.

The class is similar to the Class 220 Voyager, but was built with a tilting mechanism enabling up to six degrees of tilt to allow higher speeds on curved tracks. Additionally, most have five coaches, and they have a different bogie design. They have a maximum speed of 125 mph (200 km/h).

This resource pack is to add the Avanti West Coast BR Class 221 into Minecraft with Minecraft Transit Railway mod, made by PlaneSimple for Transport Fever 2 and Converted to Minecraft by Vitor2005 in 2025.

mtr4-grand-central-br-class-221-super-vo:
Overview
 
The British Rail Class 221 Super Voyager is a class of tilting diesel-electric multiple unit express passenger trains built in Bruges, Belgium and Wakefield, by Bombardier Transportation in 2001–02.

The class is similar to the Class 220 Voyager, but was built with a tilting mechanism enabling up to six degrees of tilt to allow higher speeds on curved tracks. Additionally, most have five coaches, and they have a different bogie design. They have a maximum speed of 125 mph (200 km/h).

 This resource pack is to add the Grand Central (EX-Avanti West Coast) BR Class 221 into Minecraft with Minecraft Transit Railway mod, made by PlaneSimple for Transport Fever 2 and Converted to Minecraft by Vitor2005 in 2026.

 Disclaimer
This resource pack is not associated with, and is not an official product of, Grand Central.

Raycasted Anti-ESP was formerly known as Raycasted Entity Occlusions (REO). v1.x versions still maintain this name, while v2.x versions (currently in alpha, with version numbers v0.x.x) are using the new name.

 Introduction
RaycastedAntiESP is a packet-based plugin for Paper, Folia, and its forks that hides entities (including players) and tile entities (blocks such as chests, banners, signs, etc) from players if they would not be visible to a legitimate player. It is unbypassable by design, as packets sent by the server are blocked from reaching the client unless the block/entity has been confirmed to be visible.
This limits the usefulness of unfair advantages such as cheat clients, freecam, and x-ray, and completely blocks pie-ray.

 Supported Versions

 Requirements
- Paper 1.21.6 (26.1.2) or compatible
- Fabric client with Jade mod installed

 How It Works
The plugin intercepts Jade's custom network payloads using Paper's plugin messaging system. When a Fabric client joins:
1. Client sends jade:client handshake with protocol version

4. Plugin queries the server world and responds with jade:receive data (NBT format)

Better Floodgate Whitelist
 Better Floodgate Whitelist is a plugin for managing floodgate players on your whitelist. It allows you to easily add and remove Bedrock players to the whitelist.

 Commands: 

- /bfw add - Add a Bedrock player to the whitelist
- /bfw remove - Remove a Bedrock player from the whitelist

 Why install this plugin? 

Floodgates implementation of a whitelist is very unreliable and sometimes won't let you whitelist players without their FUUID. This plugin automatically finds players FUUID and then adds them to the whitelist.

 How does it work? 

Better Floodgate Whitelist sends a request to the MCCompanion API whenever you add someone to the whitelist. This allows you to whitelist players that have never joined a server with floodgate.

armouredelytra:
Armoured Elytra

Smith a chestplate + an elytra together and get one item that flies, protects, and actually looks like both. Most plugins that do this just render a plain elytra and you lose your armour's look — this one draws the wings and the chestplate at the same time, using vanilla's own equipment asset system. Cape/elytra texture still shows up too.

The item is literally your chestplate under the hood (same armour, toughness, durability, enchants, dye), it just also has the glider component and a combined-layer texture. So there's basically no custom mechanics to break.

 Which file

- 1.21.3+ (incl. 26.x) – ArmouredElytra-x.jar , the full thing with the combined look.
- 1.9.4 – 1.21.1 – ArmouredElytra-Legacy-x.jar . Before 1.21.2 the game only lets a real elytra glide and can't draw armour on it, so here you get an elytra carrying the chestplate's armour, toughness and enchants.
